quote: Spearman's correlation coefficient with human similarity ratings is the standard evaluation metric for C-STS
Spearman's correlation coefficient with human similarity ratings is the standard evaluation metric for C-STS, where a high correlation indicates an accurate C-STS model.

methods: few-shot prompt with similarity ratings (1-5) and human-written justifications
arithmetic mean of human and LLM ratings
criteria: similarity rating with respect to condition

guideline: We find that the condition statements are clearer and more specific and in most condition statements, only stopwords are removed. Importantly, we do not find any conditions that degrade in quality or meaning altered significantly. On the other hand, we found that that 23% (69/300) of the original human ratings to be inaccurate.
